name: 回血药剂
describe: 装备后每回合恢复5%的血量
describe_en: Recovers 5% HP per round after equipping it.

name: 龙鳞
describe: 龙身上的鳞片，极为珍贵的材料，只有龙类怪物掉落
describe_en: Scale from dragons, a kind of very precious material, only dropped from drake monsters.

name: 普通强化石
describe: 强化装备的宝石，大部分怪物都会掉落。
describe_en: A stone to enhance equipment, can be dropped from most monsters.

name: 魔力之石
describe: 神奇的魔法石可以用来重铸装备属性,深渊，黑市中获得。
describe_en: Can be used to reform the attribute of equipment. Can be obtained in abyss and Shop.

name: 复活石
describe: 非常珍贵的魔法石，每场战斗仅可使用一次。
describe_en: Can be used only once during each battle.

name: 地牢钥匙
describe_en: Can be used to open the dungeon.

name: 宝库钥匙
describe: 用来开启宝箱，来源于深渊和商店
describe_en: Can be used to open the chest. Can be obtained from abyss and shop.

name: 深渊徽记
describe: 猎魔勇士挑战深渊获得的荣誉非常珍贵 可用来兑换深渊宝物
describe_en: Honor obtained from challenging abyss, really precious. Can be used to exchange for abyss treasure.

name: 副本卷轴
describe: 用来解除副本封印，进入副本必须物品。BOSS，特殊怪物掉落，黑市中也可获得。
describe_en: Can be used to remove instance seals. It is a must to enter instances. Can be dropped from Bosses and special monsters.

name: BOSS召唤卷轴
describe_en: Can be used to summon BOSS.

name: 魔法印记
describe: 受到魔法破坏 但还有着一丝魔法力量
describe_en: Got damaged by magic, but still possesses a slice of magic power.

name: 幸运宝箱
describe: 开启宝箱有几率获得特殊装备,金币,强化石,燕雀石,火焰之心,沙虫晶核等珍贵的材料
describe_en: Have chance to get special equipment, gold, enhancement stone, machalite ore, heart of fire, crystal nucleus and other precious materials.

name: 铁矿石
describe: 普通的矿石可用来打造武器,来源广泛人类,兽人喜欢收集它
describe_en: Can be used to forge weapons. Can be obtained from everywhere. Humans and orc like to collet it.

name: 秘银
describe: 稀有金属，用它可以打造出优良的装备,部分Boss会掉落来源广泛
describe_en: Can be used to forge great weapons. Can be obtained from everywhere. Part of Bosses will drop it.

name: 燕雀石
describe: 极为珍贵的材料，打造史诗级装备必备材料，BOSS，特殊怪物,副本,合成,黑市中也可获得
describe_en: Necessity for forging epic equipment. Can be obtained from BOSSes, special monsters, instances, synthesis and Shop.

name: 水晶石
describe: 稀有材料可用来打造珠宝首饰，来源较广泛(Boss,高级怪物)掉落
describe_en: Can be used to forge jewelries and accessories. Bosses and senior monsters will drop it.

name: 大地结晶
describe: 珍贵的材料打造传说级武器饰品必备材料,部分Boss掉落,黑市也可获得
describe_en: Necessity for forging legendary equipment. Can be obtained from some Bosses and Shop.

name: 翡翠
describe: 珍贵的材料用来升级特殊装备,副本,深渊掉落
describe_en: Can be used to upgrade special equipment. Can be obtained in instances and abyss.

name: 血石
describe: 极为珍贵的材料,可用来升级特殊装备,深渊18层以上掉落
describe_en: Extremely precious material. Can be used to upgrade special equipment. Can be obtained in the 18th or higher floors of the abyss.

name: 牙齿
describe: 普通的装备材料，低级野兽类怪物掉落
describe_en: Common equipment material. Dropped by junior beast monsters.

name: 骨头
describe: 普通的装备材料，低级野兽类怪物掉落
describe_en: Common equipment material. Dropped by junior beast monsters.

name: 皮革
describe: 普通的装备材料，野兽类怪物掉落
describe_en: Common equipment material. Dropped by beast monsters.

name: 利爪
describe: 普通的装备材料，野兽类怪物掉落
describe_en: Common equipment material. Dropped by beast monsters.

name: 鳞片
describe: 鳞片，优质材料，蛇，鳄鱼等怪物掉落
describe_en: High quality material. Dropped by snakes, crocodiles and other monsters.

name: 毛皮
describe: 优质材料，高级野兽掉落
describe_en: High quality material. Dropped by senior monsters.

name: 龙翼
describe: 极为珍贵的材料，龙类怪物掉落,挑战副本也有低概率掉
describe_en: Extremely precious material. Dropped by drake monsters. Have low chance to obtain it in challenge instances.

name: 龙牙
describe: 龙的牙齿，极为珍贵的材料，只有龙类怪物掉落
describe_en: Fang of dragons, extremely precious material. Only dropped by drake monster.

name: 灵魂之尘
describe: 优质的材料，骷髅，死灵类怪物掉落
describe_en: High quality material. Dropped by skeletons and wraiths.

name: 邪恶之眼
describe: 珍贵的材料，高级亡灵,怨灵掉落
describe_en: Precious material. Dropped by the undead and spectres.

name: 魔法精华
describe: 稀有的材料，法师，巫师，祭祀等使用魔法的敌人掉落,部分BOSS也有几率掉落
describe_en: Rare material. Dropped by enemies like witches, priests, wizards and others who use magic. Some bosses have chance to drop it.

name: 天使之泪
describe: 极为珍贵的材料,可由特殊装备分解获得
describe_en: Extremely precious material. Can be obtained from special equipment decomposition.

name: 能量之源
describe: 蕴含着神秘魔法能量，极为珍贵的材料
describe_en: Extremely precious material. There's mysterious magic power in it.

name: 灵魂结晶
describe: 珍贵的材料,深渊掉落,可用来升级特殊装备
describe_en: Precious material. Can be used to upgrade special equipment. Can be obtained from instances and abyss.

name: 10000金币
describe_en: Can obtain 10,000 gold after selling it.

name: 100000金币
describe_en: Can obtain 100,000 gold after selling it.

name: 300000金币
describe_en: Can obtain 300,000 gold after selling it.

name: 沙虫晶核
describe: 非常珍贵的材料，死亡沙虫掉落
describe_en: Really precious material. Dropped by sandworms.

name: 元素粉末
describe: 稀有材料，精灵祭祀,精灵刺客，火焰怪等怪物掉落，来源比较广泛
describe_en: Rare material. Dropped by elven priests, elven assassins, flame monsters and other monsters.

name: 大骨
describe_en: Precious material. Dropped by beast Bosses.

name: 恶魔之心
describe: 非常珍贵的材料，恶魔类怪物(恶魔城主，恶魔猎手)掉落
describe_en: Really precious material. Dropped by demon monsters (demon lords, demon hunters).

name: 火焰之心
describe: 非常珍贵的材料，火山巨人掉落
describe_en: Really precious material. Dropped by volcano giants.

name: 虫壳
describe: 普通的材料，虫类怪物掉落
describe_en: Common material. Dropped by worm monsters.

name: 巨爪
describe_en: Precious material. Dropped by beast Bosses.

name: 染料
describe: 优质的材料，来源广泛僵尸骷髅类怪物掉落
describe_en: High quality material. Dropped by zombies and skeletons.

name: 高级染料
describe: 珍贵的材料，高级僵尸骷髅类怪物掉落
describe_en: Precious material. Dropped by senior zombies and skeletons.

name: 恶魔之血
describe: 非常珍贵的材料，恶魔类怪物(恶魔城主，恶魔猎手)掉落
describe_en: Really precious material. Dropped by demon monsters (demon lords, demon hunters).

name: 神秘的藏宝图
describe: 冒险家们梦寐以求的藏宝图
describe_en: The map is the dream which captivated all adventurers.

name: 邪恶地下城卷轴
describe: 传送到一个古老而又神秘的地下城
describe_en: Teleports to an ancient and mystery dungeon.

name: 矿锄
describe: 装备后可以在矿山，矿洞中进行挖矿
describe_en: Enables you to dig mines after equipping it.

name: 高级矿锄
describe: 装备后可以在矿山，矿洞中进行挖矿
describe_en: Enables you to dig mines after equipping it.

name: 幸运药剂
describe: 装备后每场战斗物品掉落概率增加100%
describe_en: Drop rate of every item increases by 100% after equipping it.

name: 经验药剂
describe: 装备后战斗经验获得提升100%
describe_en: Exp obtained from every battle increases by 100% after equipping it.

name: 高级强化石
describe: 强化+15以上的装备，主要由深渊获得,挑战副本低概率掉落。
describe_en: Enhances equipment higher than +15. Can be obtained mainly from abyss. Have low chance to obtain it in challenge instances.

name: 神秘晶石
describe: 极为珍贵的材料,可通过深渊,宝箱,宝箱怪,兑换获得。来源广泛但是概率很低。60级以后可在铁匠铺中合成特殊装备
describe_en: The most precious materials, abyss, chest, exchange can be obtained.

name: 五一活动金币
describe: 用来兑换五一活动装备(限时)。副本,深渊,冒险BOSS(低概率)掉落。(有效期5.1~5.3)
describe_en: Can be used to exchange for event equipment (limited time). Dropped from instances, abyss and adventure BOSS (low chance). (Effective duration: 5.1~5.3)

name: 挑战副本卷轴
describe: 进入挑战副本必须物品。可通过合成,黑市获得。
describe_en: Necessity to enter the challenge instances. Can be obtained from synthesis and Shop.

name: 狱岩石
describe: 极为珍贵的材料，深渊掉落
describe_en: Extremely precious material. Can be obtained from abyss.

name: 糯米
describe: 端午节活动道具,可用来兑换活动装备(限时)。副本,深渊,冒险BOSS(低概率)掉落。
describe_en: Item of dragon-boat festival event. Can be used to exchange for event equipment (limited time). Dropped from instances, abyss and adventure BOSS (low chance).

name: 神器碎片
describe: 分解神器获得,可用于神器升星,洗星
describe_en: Can be obtained from divine equipment decomposition.

name: 金币(活动)
describe: 用来兑换活动道具(限时)。副本,深渊,冒险BOSS(低概率),流浪哥布林掉落。
describe_en: Can be used to exchange for event equipment (limited time). Dropped from instances, abyss and adventure BOSS (low chance). (Effective duration: 5.1~5.3)

name: 金币(元旦活动)
describe: 用来兑换活动道具(限时)。副本,深渊,冒险BOSS(低概率),流浪哥布林掉落。
describe_en: Can be used to exchange for event equipment (limited time). Dropped from instances, abyss and adventure BOSS (low chance). (Effective duration: 5.1~5.3)

describe_en: Can be used to exchange for event equipment (limited time). Dropped from instances, abyss and adventure BOSS (low chance). (Effective duration: 5.1~5.3)

name: 藏宝图
describe: 可根据地图中的线索找到宝藏,据说有很大的概率发现神器装备
describe_en: According to clues can find precious treasure.

name: 藏宝图碎片
describe: 可以在铁匠铺中合成藏宝图,可通过兑换,挑战Boss,隐藏怪物,神秘宝箱获得
describe_en: In the blacksmith can make treasure map.

name: Boss挑战卷
describe_en: Can be used to challenge boss.

name: 能量之源
describe: 蕴含着神秘魔法能量，极为珍贵的材料,可通过铁匠铺熔炼获得
describe_en: Extremely precious material. There's mysterious magic power in it.Get by smelt in Alchemy.

name: 宠物精魂
describe: 可通过放生宠物,捉宠,神秘宝箱中获得 用于提高捉宠概率，喂养宠物提高宠物忠诚
describe_en: Get by give up pets and treasure boxes

name: 随机副本卷轴
describe: 80级以后可用于挑战随机副本。黑市,宝藏,副本,深渊中低概率掉落
describe_en: After Level 80 can be used to challenge random instance

name: 徽章附魔石
describe: 用于徽章附魔,铁匠铺中可合成,黑市,宝箱,随机副本中可以获得
describe_en: Can be used to Enchant Badge.

name: 金币箱子
describe: 铁匠铺中可合成,用来储存多余的金币。价值1亿金币。(注:游戏金币上限20亿超过后将不会再获得金币)
describe_en: Used to store gold.Sell it can get 100 million gold.(Tip: Game gold limit of 2 billion)

name: 经验卷轴
describe: 增加50%战斗经验。可持续3000只怪物。

name: 幸运药水
describe: 增加20%物品掉落,20%金币获得,20%隐藏怪物出现概率。可持续3000只怪物。
